scripts.title: Holding the Line
scripts.logline: When street unrest shatters a pop-culture store, a determined clerk defends his sanctuary until unexpected protectors step in.
scripts.logline_de: Als Straßenschlachten einen Popkultur-Laden verwüsten, verteidigt ein standhafter Verkäufer sein Refugium, bis unerwartete Helfer eingreifen.

setting.location: Fictional urban district, arcade commercial street
setting.weather: Overcast, cool breeze blowing street debris
setting.color_palette: Desaturated slate grey, broken glass reflections, neon cyan and deep amber pops
setting.art_style: High-contrast cinematic anime, MAPPA-inspired, gritty line art, sharp rim lighting

characters.name: Ren
characters.design_sheet: Ren: 32yo man, stocky broad build, short messy navy-blue undercut hair, determined amber eyes, light neat stubble. Plain black oversized zip-up hoodie over charcoal shirt, dark cargo pants. Gritty anime aesthetic.
changed_de: Dunkelblaue Haare mit Undercut statt realer Frisur/Haarfarbe
Gepflegter kurzer Stoppelbart statt realer Gesichtsbehaarung
Keine Markenlogos oder reale Aufdrucke auf der Kleidung
characters.voice: Deep, raspy, strained yet calm voice

characters.name: Kaito
characters.design_sheet: Kaito: 18yo male, tall lean build, unruly ash-brown shaggy hair, sharp dark grey eyes. Off-white oversized windbreaker jacket, black track pants. Cinematic anime style.
inspired_by_scene_de: Rolle des unbeteiligten Passanten, der schlichtend dazwischentritt
changed_de: Neutrales weiß-graues Windbreaker-Design ohne reale Kennzeichen

shots.camera: Low angle, medium close-up, Dutch tilt
shots.action: Ren stands defiantly inside a shattered shop entryway as glass fragments fall in slow motion.
shots.voiceover: Some places are worth standing for.
shots.music: Low sub-bass drone rising into tense strings
shots.image_prompt: Ren, 32yo man, stocky broad build, messy navy-blue undercut hair, amber eyes, black oversized hoodie. Low angle Dutch tilt, broken shop doorway, floating glass shards, neon reflections, cinematic anime, gritty MAPPA style, 9:16 vertical.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow motion camera track-in, glass particles glitter and drop, character breath visible, sudden speed-up at end.

shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder, looking out into chaotic street
shots.action: Ren surveys the street filled with trash and fleeing crowds, standing right before the cracked glass threshold.
shots.image_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot behind Ren in black hoodie, looking outward at litter-covered city pavement, distant crowd silhouettes, broken shopfront framing, moody anime lighting, 9:16 vertical.
shots.motion_prompt: Handheld jitter camera, smoke and debris drift across foreground, Ren tenses his shoulders.

shots.camera: Dynamic side tracking shot, sudden crash zoom
shots.action: A masked rioter lunges and strikes Ren in the back; impact frames flash as Ren stumbles onto the sidewalk.
shots.music: Harsh distortion strike cutting the synth line
shots.image_prompt: Action impact scene, masked silhouette striking Ren from behind, anime speed lines, black hoodie ripples, flying glass debris on pavement, high contrast lighting, 9:16 vertical.
shots.motion_prompt: Rapid lateral pan, black and white impact frames at contact, camera shake, Ren stumbles forward in slow motion recovery.

shots.action: As the attacker moves forward again, Kaito and other youths rush in, spreading their arms wide to form a human wall.
shots.music: Sudden drop into solitary ringing frequency
shots.image_prompt: Kaito, 18yo with ash-brown shaggy hair and light windbreaker, arms wide open shielding Ren, street crowd background, dramatic anime lighting, 9:16 vertical.
shots.motion_prompt: Quick forward step animation, arms snap outward, dust and trash kick up from asphalt, camera stabilizes.

shots.camera: Extreme close-up on Ren's eyes, panning down to clenched fists
shots.action: Ren steadies his breathing, eyes narrowing with shock turning into resolve; the attacker hesitates and steps back.
shots.music: Slow, emotional cello chord enters over sub-bass
shots.image_prompt: Extreme close-up anime shot, Ren's intense amber eyes, tiny cut on cheekbone, sweat drop, reflection of standing protectors in pupil, high detail gritty anime style, 9:16 vertical.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle pupil focus shift, slow camera tilt down to trembling clenched fist locking into a steady grip.

shots.camera: Medium full shot, static, slight low angle
shots.action: Ren stands tall inside the ruined doorway beside a faded superhero poster, watching the street calm down.
shots.voiceover: Even when everything shatters... we hold our ground.
shots.image_prompt: Ren in black hoodie standing inside broken glass store frame, next to a colorful anime hero poster, dusk light hitting his face, peaceful determined expression, 9:16 vertical.
shots.motion_prompt: Static shot with wind blowing Ren's bangs and poster paper corner, soft ambient light flicker.

shots.camera: Static wide street shot with centered typography
shots.action: Wide view of the glass-covered street at twilight as the end card displays.
shots.on_screen_text: Fictional story inspired by real events.
shots.image_prompt: Dim neon street corner at dusk, broken glass reflecting streetlights on pavement, quiet atmosphere, cinematic anime, 9:16 vertical.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow fade to black, glowing end card text emerges in center screen.

music.mood: Tense, aggressive, shifting to emotional and grounded solidarity

source.event: Vor einem Ladenlokal in einer Einkaufsstraße liegen Scherben und Gegenstände auf dem Boden. Ein Mann verteidigt den beschädigten Eingangsbereich eines Geschäfts, wird dabei von Passanten konfrontiert und körperlich angegriffen. Umstehende greifen deeskalierend ein und rufen zum Aufhören auf, woraufhin der Mann sichtbar mitgenommen im zerstörten Schaufensterrahmen stehen bleibt.
